description: VisualVerdict says whether Gemini could inspect the cited screenshots and whether their visible contents support the report's visual claims.

review_completed.description: ReviewCompleted is false when Gemini could not open all cited screenshots.

supported.description: Supported is true only when every inspected screenshot supports its caption, reference, and visible claim.

opened_images.description: OpenedImages lists the exact paths Gemini opened with its image-viewing tool.

feedback.description: Feedback identifies each mismatch or evidence limitation precisely enough for correction or triage.
